questions.question: Dr Sami must train young dentists in surgery. What is the first advice he should give them?
options: Surgery is a simple technical act
Surgery requires good knowledge of anatomy and precise gestures
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Surgery requires good knowledge of anatomy and precise gestures.' Dr Mina adds: 'And a lot of practice!'

questions.question: Dr Mina must create a surgery training center. What is the main objective?
options: Train competent surgeons aware of risks
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The main objective is to train competent surgeons aware of risks.' Dr Sami: 'I'll participate in the training.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must evaluate a young surgeon's performance. Which measure is the most important?
options: Quality of gestures and patient safety
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Quality of gestures and patient safety are the most important measures.' Dr Mina: 'I agree with you.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must manage a crisis: a patient has presented a postoperative complication. What is the priority?
options: Identify the cause of the complication
Protect the patient and stabilize their condition
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The priority is to protect the patient and stabilize their condition.' Dr Sami: 'I'll help you.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must train residents in risk management in surgery. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Risk management is a legal obligation
Risk management is an ethical responsibility towards patients
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Risk management is a fundamental ethical responsibility towards patients.' Dr Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must create a good practice guide for surgery. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Good practices must be based on updated scientific data.' Dr Sami: 'I'll contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must train young surgeons in communication with patients. What is the key message?
options: Surgery is a safe act, but risks exist
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'The patient must be informed of the risks while being reassured.' Dr Mina: 'Transparency is essential.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must create a research program in surgery. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Research in surgery aims to improve clinical practices and patient safety.' Dr Sami: 'I'll participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must manage a reference practice in surgery. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Excellence is based on continuing education and patient safety.' Dr Mina: 'I agree with you.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must evaluate the impact of surgery on public health. What is the role of surgery?
options: It is an essential tool for oral care
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Surgery is an essential tool for oral care.' Dr Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must train residents in innovation in surgery. Which current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Innovation in surgery concerns techniques, digital guidance and materials.' Dr Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must create a skills assessment system in surgery. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Skills assessment aims to improve the quality of care.' Dr Sami: 'I'll participate in the assessment.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must manage an ethical conflict in surgery. What is the right attitude?
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Deontology is the essential guide for resolving ethical conflicts.' Dr Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must write an article on the future of oral surgery. Which trend should be highlighted?
options: Technological innovation in service to the patient
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The future of surgery is based on technological innovation in service to the patient.' Dr Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must create a quality label for surgical practices. What are the main criteria?
options: Safety, training and quality of care
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Safety, training and quality of care are the fundamental criteria for a quality label.' Dr Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
options: The profession needs passionate and visionary people
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The profession needs passionate people to continue evolving.' Dr Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must create a scholarship for students in surgery. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Encouraging excellence in surgery is an investment for the future.' Dr Mina: 'I'll support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must pass on her knowledge in surgery. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Personalized mentoring and practical cases are the most effective methods for passing on knowledge.' Dr Sami: 'I'll invest in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must create a peer network for young surgeons. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young surgeons.' Dr Mina: 'I'll support this network.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must write a conclusion to her work on surgery. What is the final sentence?
options: Surgery is an art in service to the patient
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Surgery is an art in service to the patient.' Dr Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Values and example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must train future mentors in surgery. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of accompaniment and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of accompaniment and transmission.' Dr Sami: 'I'll pass on this message.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must write a letter to future surgeons. What message should he convey?
options: Surgery is a discipline that deserves to be practiced
questions.explanation: Dr Sami explains: 'Surgery is a discipline that deserves to be practiced with passion and rigor.' Dr Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must create a prize for innovative young surgeons. What is the goal?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Innovation and creativity are the drivers of evolution in surgery.' Dr Sami: 'I'll support this prize.'

questions.question: Dr Sami, after a life dedicated to surgery, receives a national tribute. Dr Mina is by his side. What is Dr Sami's message to young surgeons?
questions.explanation: Dr Sami concludes: 'Surgery needs passion and dedication to continue evolving.' Dr Mina: 'I'm proud of you.'
